public.text: The Terminology Service is said to manage ATC, UNSPSC, GPC, dosage form, route, and units. Some of these classifications or reference datasets may have licensing, distribution, or governance conditions and may not be suitable for direct terminology-server representation without profiling.
public.suggestedRevision: Document the authoritative source, version, licence, representation, mapping, and national governance approach for every classification and value set.
